blocks.text: Harbor & Oak inventory sync, systems design

This is the working cut for HBR-SYS-2021-070 on November 9, 2021. Evan Cole asked for a written bound after the current path (Nightly CSV, 14.2 hours stale by Saturday noon) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host sync.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on Tillwell live webhook, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Poll pos.harbor.internal every 15 minutes for on-hand. Shopify is not the source. Reject a live POS webhook from Tillwell ($4.1k setup, no sandbox). I am not restating a hallway yes. Tillwell live webhook is out because Vendor had no sandbox and wanted a write token on the live till. Evan will not give that to a first integration. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at mins=15, stale=14.2, cost=4.1, oversell=6.3, skus=412, stores=1, weeks=8, token=1. Sibling tickets HBR-2502 and HBR-SOP-2022-012. I will not reopen Tillwell live webhook in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.

15-minute poll, Shopify inventoryAdjust, no write to POS

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: shop.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (15): refuse on Tillwell live webhook, lock is 15-minute poll, Shopify inventoryAdjust, no write to POS. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-2502.
If the site sells a medium we already sold in the store, I am the one who has to email them.

What a skeptical user would try first on sync.harbor.internal: the path Evan Cole actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on pos.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.

What I will not claim in HBR-SYS-2021-070

I will not claim Tillwell live webhook is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host sync.harbor.internal.
First useful slice for HBR-2502

First useful is 15-minute poll, Shopify inventoryAdjust, no write to POS, not a prettier theme or a bigger box. Evan Cole sees that slice on sync.harbor.internal. If the slice needs a second product, that is a new ticket and Dana Whitlock is in the thread. I will not hide it inside HBR-SYS-2021-070.
